description:
## Goal

Workspace-sandbox `/processes` does not currently record exit codes for tracked background processes. The SandboxLauncher therefore reports `exitCode=0` on natural exit and `exitCode=1` as a placeholder when the process disappeared. Add structured exit-code recording so the runner can distinguish runner-process success vs failure precisely (matching the host launcher).

## Expected deliverables

1. A `status=exited` row on `/processes` carries the actual exit code, signal (if any), and OOMKilled flag.
2. SandboxLauncher.checkExited reads the recorded exit code and returns it via `remoteExitError.ExitCode`.
3. Runner-level test that compares exit-code propagation between HostLauncher and SandboxLauncher (parity).
4. Update `PROTECTED_MODE_RUNNERS.md` capability matrix `Exit code propagation` row from "placeholder" to "verified".

## Key references

- `scenarios/workspace-sandbox/api/internal/handlers/process.go` (GetProcesses)
- `scenarios/agent-manager/api/internal/adapters/sandbox/sandbox_launcher.go` (checkExited, remoteExitError)
- `scenarios/agent-manager/docs/PROTECTED_MODE_RUNNERS.md`
